Vorrei essere messa in contatto con un responsabile o un operatore di livello superiore che possa verificare concretamente il problema sul mio account.


L'ordine va a buon fine e poi si cancella
Mi dice :A causa di un problema di trasmissione dei dati di pagamento, non è stato possibile concludere l’acquisto.

Ho provato da diversi account, ho pagato Con diversi metodi di pagamento.

Sono diversi mesi che va avanti questo problema e vi ho contattati mille volte senza risolvere nulla.

Grazie

reviews.text: Hablas con atención al cliente por Whatshapp y su respuesta es "pasamos la incidencia, te contactaremos" y NUNCA te contactan. He hecho mil pedidos en Shein y jamás he tenido un solo problema, hago uno en Zara y tengo 65 euros perdidos en dos productos que ni siquiera sé si llegarán ni que solución aportarán, ya que su respuesta es siempre "vuelve a contactar mañana". Cuando insistes finalizan ellos mismos la conversación y te pasan con otra persona que repite lo mismo. Llevo 14 años trabajando en empresas en roles de atención al cliente y JAMÁS he visto nada parecido. Las prendas de Zara serán de calidad, pero su servicio está al nivel de una empresa china. Se potessi dare zero stelle, lo farei.

reviews.title: delusione
reviews.text:
Esperienza con lo shop online e l'assistenza clienti a dir poco pessima. Su sei capi acquistati mi è arrivato un unico articolo che non faceva parte del mio ordine  e che da solo costava il doppio dell'intero carrello.
Cercare di risolvere la cosa tramite la chat è stato un incubo: ci sono solo bot automatizzati, non c'è modo di parlare con un umano e gli operatori si limitano a rimandare ad attese di 48-72 ore che non portano a nulla.
Alla fine, per non perdere la mia spesa, sono dovuta andare andare di persona al negozio Zara di Pisa. Dopo oltre mezz'ora di telefonate e verifiche, solo grazie alla grande gentilezza, pazienza e competenza del personale in store la situazione è stata risolta con il riordino dei capi giusti.
Metto una stella perché un marchio del genere non può basarsi su un'assistenza online così inefficiente, scaricando i problemi sulla buona volontà dei dipendenti dei negozi. È stata solo fortuna aver trovato persone valide in store, ma il supporto digitale è bocciato su tutta la linea.

reviews.title: Zara App Just awful
reviews.text:
Without a doubt, the worst shopping app I’ve ever used.

The Zara app is an absolute mess. It’s slow, glitchy, confusing, and seems to have been designed by people who have never actually used it themselves. Finding anything is like trying to solve a puzzle. The search function is hopeless, the categories make no sense, and products seem to vanish into thin air the moment you try to find them again.

Every update somehow makes it worse. Instead of making shopping easier, the app turns a simple task into an exercise in frustration. Endless scrolling, poor navigation, random glitches, and a layout that prioritises looking trendy over being functional.

I genuinely don’t understand how a global brand can have an app this bad. If I could give it zero stars, I would. Shopping should not be this difficult. Sort it out, Zara.

reviews.text: Made an order on the 29th May on behalf of my nan and it said it would come the next day, or the day after. Since the 29th, we’ve still been waiting and it’s gone way past this pretend date that they keep moving. It’s now the 11th June. Why broadcast something saying how fast the shipping and delivery is and then turn it around and make it to the point of a 70 year old woman sat at a door all day seeing delivery drivers drive past and getting her hopes up because now she’s spent around 50 quid and thinks she’s been scammed at this point. Not impressed as usually it isn’t like this 🙁

reviews.title: Faulty app/incorrect shipment- in app help could care less
reviews.text:
I ordered an over price outfit for my baby’s first birthday. I literally planned the decorations around the damn outfit.
They sent the wrong size.
I double checked what I ordered and they sent the wrong item.
The party is Sunday, and I can’t get it shipped in time via the app options so I contacted their helpdesk to see if they could have it shipped out and possibly comp me the cost of express shipping shipping as the error was their fault. The resolution I was offered was for them to mail me a return label. And for them to mail out the correct item once they receive the return back at their warehouse. I pushback and asked if there was anyone else I could talk to or if there was anything else and that was the only resolution I was offered besides just a plain return label.
This was probably the worst customer service I have ever encountered. Also, the app is annoying and its interface is not intuitive.

reviews.text: I made one purchase through the website and everything went as expected. I tried twice to purchase through the app and both times the money was held on my card and it appeared as if everything was fine, A few days later the app showed that the purchase was cancelled and did not explain why, and then the money was eventually returned to my card. I live outside of the country I’m from, so I figured that it was cancelled because there was a problem charging my card from outside the country. I tried to make another purchase and this time I used the card from the country where I live and the money was withdrawn through a transfer from my account, and now the app is saying that I still have to pay to finish the order. I have less confidence that this will be as easy to resolve with my foreign bank account. What is wrong with this app that you can’t purchase safely?

reviews.text:
Please can we have an option to stop moving flickering images. Product images are also confusing, eg woman wearing a top but you’re actually selling earrings, so why is the image a top? 

I can’t go to the stores because they are saturated with the perfumes. Now online is just as frustrating.

I don’t want to have a life story or some sort of weird mini movie and odd images coming up. Can we please just stick to the basic format of shopping online without all the pretentious unnecessary stuff everywhere?? I just want to shop online. I’m not here for an ‘experience’. 

You’re still stuck in the old ZARA editorial mindset. Trying to make the website different rather than making it user-friendly and simple to check out. 

You need to sort out your menus at the start of the homepage because they are really messy, why are you labelling departments 1234 and five? This is an online store. reviews.title: Extremely Disappointed with Zara’s Delivery and Customer Service
reviews.text:
Extremely Disappointed with Zara’s Delivery and Customer Service

I placed an order with Zara and paid extra for delivery. The delivery was handled by Better Trucks Last Mile Delivery, and the experience was completely unacceptable.

The courier left my package inside the building, directly at the entrance where people enter and exit to the street, a high-traffic area with constant foot traffic. This is despite the fact that:
	•	our building has secure lockers,
	•	many delivery services deliver directly to apartment doors,
	•	no attempt was made to place the package in a secure or appropriate location.

On top of that, I never received any delivery notification or message, which would have allowed me to retrieve the package in time. Because of this negligence, the package was left unattended and was stolen.

What is most disappointing is that Zara refused to issue a refund, even though the delivery was clearly mishandled. I fulfilled my responsibilities as a customer, yet I was left to bear the consequences of the delivery company’s failure.

For a global brand like Zara, this level of service is shameful and unacceptable. There is a complete lack of accountability and care for customers. After this experience, my trust is gone but probably nobody cares

La nuova frontiera Greenwashing di Zara è la possibilità di poter vendere i tuoi vestiti usati. Peccato che l’app sia incredibilmente obsoleta e l’assistenza completamente inutile. Non è possibile prolungare di qualche  giorno la spedizione (che non tiene conto di festivi e/o domeniche), non è possibile interloquire in alcun modo con l’acquirente o dare conferma di avvenuta spedizione (come su altre piattaforme). Su 3 articoli venduti, tutte e 3 le volte ho avuto problemi e l’assistenza è gestita da IA (ovviamente ) e le poche volte in cui rispondono operatori umani sanno solo dirti che il tuo caso è monitorato e ti aggiorneranno a breve (cosa che non succede mai).
L’app, tra l’altro, ha un’interfaccia tutt’altro che immediata e intuitiva.
Sconsiglio.

reviews.title: Supporto clienti praticamente inesistente
reviews.text:
Esperienza deludente. Ho effettuato un ordine in negozio con l’aiuto di una commessa perché non era disponibile la mia taglia. Dopo una settimana è arrivato il pacco, ma il modello ricevuto non era quello richiesto.

Il problema principale, però, è l’assenza totale di riscontro da parte dell’assistenza: ho provato a contattarli per tutta la giornata senza ottenere risposta. Inoltre, leggendo i termini e le condizioni, risulta che il reso sarebbe a mio carico e che il prodotto corretto verrebbe inviato solo dopo il rientro dell’articolo sbagliato, con ulteriori attese.

Un servizio clienti così poco reattivo rende la gestione degli errori piuttosto complicata.
